answer: Use a random arrival ticket lottery: each identity commits before a public randomness beacon reveals the round seed, and only tickets under the cutoff may transact. Since the seed appears after commitments, an attacker cannot precompute winners, so each duplicate pays one fresh unpredictable wait plus a signed challenge round-trip. No one can thread many cheap identities through that gate without paying each cost, and spare agents can only wander the waiting area while admitted agents gather nectar.
